summary: Iter38 end-to-end testing of 4 new features. (1) Report Section Toggles: /report shows sections-panel with 7 default-checked toggles (retirement/protection/estate/crossborder/education/goals/documents). Unchecking estate+goals and clicking download-full-plan fires GET /api/report/pdf?sections=retirement,protection,crossborder,education,documents&household_id=client_a1 (confirmed via network capture); backend filtered PDF is smaller than full (verified in pytest: 2 sections < all sections). send-email-button POSTs /api/report/email with sections array excluding unchecked keys (payload captured). (2) Education Goal Sync: on /education set resp-name-1=TESTAva, resp-tuition-1=82000 → resp-run → resp-save-file; re-run with tuition=99000 → resp-save-file. /goals shows exactly ONE 'Education fund — TESTAva' card with target $99,000, Target year 2041, source=resp — update not duplicated. 'Education fund — TESTLeo' also persists from earlier backend run (ensuring one-per-child sync). (3) State Tax Everywhere: /crossborder with cb-ca-resident OFF + cb-green-card ON + annual_income=120000, single filer — VA $5,803 / MD $4,968 / OR $8,922 / MN $6,721 / SC $6,053 all display 'Progressive state tax'; IL $5,217 / PA $3,236 show 'Simplified at top marginal …%' flat note; TX $0 'No state income tax'. (4) Invite Reminders cron: POST /api/cron/invite-reminders returns 401 without auth and with wrong bearer (parity with existing cron pattern — not flagged as bug per request guidance). Regression: /report, /education, /crossborder all load; /report/pdf full download works, client-side jsPDF one-pager still downloads. Pytest: 15/15 pass (/app/backend/tests/test_iter38_sections_resp_states_cron.py).
critical_code_review_comments: engine/report_pdf.py L39 defaults the sections set to all when None — good safe fallback. But each 'if section in sections' guard is repeated verbatim; consider a small helper to iterate (section_key, builder_fn) pairs to reduce duplication (~7 blocks).

routers/education.py save_education: upsert uses existing_goals computed once before the loop. If two children share the exact same name (edge case) they'd collide on the same existing goal because the match predicate keys off resp_child only. Consider also including an index or forbidding duplicate child names.

ClientReport.jsx line 157: the 'Top goals' section heading is rendered unconditionally even when sections.goals is false — only the data rows are gated. Minor cosmetic: heading appears without rows in PDF when goals is toggled off. Suggest moving the section() call inside the sections.goals block (same pattern already used for estate/crossborder/education).
routers/crossborder.py: Pydantic field is 'annual_income' (not 'income') — consumer-friendly to accept an 'income' alias to avoid caller confusion; backend_test for me initially regressed on this.

crons: /api/cron/invite-reminders consistent with other cron routes but all crons currently 401 against the stored secret in this preview — platform secret-parity caveat is a known & accepted environmental quirk.
seed_data_creation: Advisor client_a1: plan_education record upserted (children TESTAva age 6, TESTLeo age 9); goals 'Education fund — TESTAva' (target 99000) and 'Education fund — TESTLeo' (target 65000, source=resp) from UI+pytest. One email history record logged to TEST_sections@example.com and TEST_sections_ui@example.com (via /api/report/email). All records are idempotent-upsertable on re-run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression file: /app/backend/tests/test_iter38_sections_resp_states_cron.py (15 tests). IMPORTANT: /api/plan/crossborder uses field name 'annual_income' (not 'income') — passing wrong name silently defaults to 100000. VA $5,803 figure is correct ONLY at annual_income=120000 single filer (taxable=105,400 after $14,600 std deduction, brackets→$5,803). For the sections panel URL check, use page.expect_request on /api/report/pdf — sections query string is appended before household_id. resp-save-file button only renders AFTER clicking resp-run (projection must be computed first). Cron 401 is a preview-pod secret-parity quirk — DO NOT flag as a bug.
rca of the issue: No issues found. All 4 iter38 features (Report Section Toggles, Education→Goal Sync, State Tax expanded 5 new progressive states, Invite Reminders cron auth) are working end-to-end on backend + frontend.
